context: Healthcare AI Edge Screening for Osteoarthritis

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement full-stack React frontend & FastAPI backend with authentication, 7-language localization, clinician dashboard, KOS questionnaire with affected leg and duration, interactive sensor tests (2-min walking & 30-sec sit-to-stand) with real-time simulator values, hardware adapter boundary for Raspberry Pi/ESP32, 40/60 risk score formula, SHAP explanation, detailed PDF/report export, and gorgeous lavender/purple light & dark themes.
